description: Retrieval baseline for colpali-rag (Qdrant local mode, RRF-60 hybrid). Dev set: evals/golden_queries.json (10 hand-checked queries). Re-verified against the full indexed corpus (5+ demo/uploaded PDFs, 26 points) on 2026-09-25 after the fusion path was re-implemented as a traced three-leg RRF.
notes: hybrid == colpali == perfect MRR/NDCG; dense text leg is the weakest (2 golds at rank 1, chart/figure-heavy queries). RRF fusion lifts every query to rank 0.
The demo corpus (demo/pdfs: NanoSat spec + SaaS cohort report, 8 chart/table-heavy pages) also retrieves its gold pages at rank 0 on all 8 scripted demo questions.
Scores are relatively small-corpus; grow the dev set toward 30-100 queries before relying on the absolute numbers.
Per-query detail (ranks, hits) is archived under evals/results/<mode>.json. Re-run with: uv run python -m colpali_rag.eval --mode hybrid --out evals/results/hybrid.json
